title: Source snapshot
description: What one source was serving at one moment, written so two of them can be compared byte for byte. The digest covers the content and not `observed_at`, so an unchanged source produces the same digest on every observation - otherwise `watch` would report a change every time it ran. `listing_complete` is the field that keeps a failed listing apart from an empty source: without it, a page that failed to load reads as every artifact having been deleted. Nothing here carries a token, a signed URL or a header, because this is the document an operator commits to a repository.

incomplete_because.description: Required whenever listing_complete is false. 'Incomplete' with no reason reads as a bug in the tool rather than a fact about the source.

declared_sha256.description: Published by whoever served the bytes. Never a value this tool computed.
